measurement: spd-w18-desk-click-latency c1 — a single press on #item-paper across 10 consecutive COLD loads
served_sha_note: reported by the harness's own PRE/POST served-commit stamp; pre == post on all 10 runs, so no deploy landed mid-measurement. 1b3856eed is an ancestor of origin/main.
viewport: headless Chrome default (--headless=new, no --window-size passed by journey.mjs); Chrome/153.0.8010.53, node v22.22.0, darwin arm64

instrument.invocation: TMPDIR=<fresh empty dir> scripts/studio-journey-smoke.sh report --legs a
instrument.reused_not_rebuilt: This is the harness shipped by PR #16603 (41de602a0) for criterion c0. Nothing was built for c1; the row's own recorded invocation was executed.
instrument.reading: the CREATE beat's check '#item-paper click patches the URL to the paper pane', which reports latency, ATTEMPT COUNT, and the three-valued wire verdict (SENT / NOT SENT / CANNOT READ) off Chrome's Network.webSocketFrameSent.

result.wire_verdict: SENT on 10/10, exactly 1 "type":"click" frame per run
result.precision_note: the harness prints one decimal; 0.1 s is the quantisation, not a rounded-away distribution.

controls.name: COLD-LOAD PROOF (not an assertion)
controls.how: journey.mjs creates its Chrome user-data-dir with fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir(),'studio-journey-') and deletes it at teardown. Each of the 10 runs was given its OWN TMPDIR, created empty by the driver and VERIFIED empty (entries_before=0) immediately before the run. A separate watched run (coldwatch) polled that directory at 2 Hz DURING the run and observed the profile appear at t=1.0s as studio-journey-pA6teo with Cookies=0 and 97 cache files, rising to 172 cache files at t=1.5s, and the directory was empty again after teardown.
controls.why_it_settles_it: cookies=0 at first observation means the cookie jar was created empty and the session cookie was written by the run's OWN ticket redeem; a growing cache from zero means the HTTP cache started empty. No state can cross runs because the profile is deleted and the next run gets a different, verified-empty directory.

controls.name: NO-RETRY CONTROL — mutation M-RETRY (an absence is never caught by inspection)
controls.how: '1 press(es)' is only evidence of no retry if the counter can print something else. Mutation M-RETRY was applied to the OFFLINE self-test fixture's #item-paper handler — 'if ((window.__mSwallowFirst = (window.__mSwallowFirst||0)+1) === 1) return;' — so the first click is swallowed and clickUntil must press again.
controls.result: the SAME check line, on the SAME clickUntil code path, printed '/good/... in 5.5s after 2 press(es) · SENT — 2 "type":"click" frame(s)' and likewise on /rot/. Unmutated the same line reads '0.5s after 1 press(es) · SENT — 1 frame'. The mutation was reverted (git checkout) and does not ship.
controls.why_it_settles_it: the attempt counter and the frame counter both move. A retry in any of the 10 live runs would have been printed.

controls.name: CAN-IT-FAIL CONTROL, OFFLINE — the harness's own self-test
controls.result: SELF-TEST PASS, 134 assertions executed (floor 40); product exits good=0, rot=1. The /rot/ arm reds LEG A 3/7 and prints NOT SENT for #item-sheet.

controls.name: CAN-IT-FAIL CONTROL, LIVE — two arms in ONE evaluation on the deployed desk
controls.how: Chrome DevTools CDP against guerrilla, authenticated by a minted login ticket, viewport 1440x900, served 1b3856eed. A SINGLE evaluate_script armed the row's named gate 3 (set data-phx-ref-src on #item-paper), pressed, polled 6 s; then removed the attribute and pressed the SAME button again in the SAME evaluation. Arming and reading never spanned two calls.
controls.result: ARM 1 (gate 3 armed): answered=false, URL unchanged after 6.010 s — SWALLOWED. ARM 2 (control, attribute removed): answered=true in 0.371 s, URL patched to /studio/paper.
controls.why_it_settles_it: the probe reports a failure and a success against the live host in the same evaluation, so a 10/10 pass is not a green with no subject. It ALSO shows the row's named swallow mechanism is still live on the deployed build.

verdict.c1: SATISFIED as written, on served 1b3856eed. 10/10 cold loads patched the URL on a single press, 0 retries, wire SENT with exactly 1 click frame each; latencies 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 1.1 / 1.3 s (min 0.3, median 0.5, max 1.3).
verdict.what_c1_does_NOT_say: c1 is a reliability claim about a press on a settled cold desk. It is not a claim that the swallow is fixed. The CAN-IT-FAIL LIVE control reproduces the swallow on this same build in 6.0 s: LiveView's bindClick still returns early on an element carrying data-phx-ref-src. The row's title defect is NOT fixed; the window in which it fires has collapsed.
verdict.why_the_window_collapsed: the harness's DESK beat reports the LiveView socket joining in 0.2 s on every run. The original filing (deployed e4ed31a10, 2026-07-29) recorded one run connecting in 4.9 s and latencies of 1.6 s / 2.4 s / never-within-15 s. The swallow window is proportional to the join latency; it did not close, it shrank.

retraction.what: the 2026-09-06 attempt note on c1 said 'NEEDS A DEPLOY, not more build ... Re-run it once 41de602a0 is live on the box.'
retraction.why_it_was_wrong: 41de602a0 touched exactly two files, tooling/studio-journey/README.md and tooling/studio-journey/journey.mjs — nothing server-side. The harness is a LOCAL client that drives a headless Chrome against a deployed host; it is never deployed. It became runnable the moment #16603 merged to main on 2026-09-06, and c1 was measurable from that day. Sixteen days were spent waiting for a deploy the criterion never needed.
retraction.separately: the prod micro-block 89.167.28.206 reports commit ca4534461 (2026-08-31) and does NOT contain 41de602a0 — but that host is irrelevant to this criterion. guerrilla, the host the harness targets by default and the host the row's own description was measured on, serves 1b3856eed.
